liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): First set opener not played since mid-70s, marking a rare return for the song [24]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): Standout performance includes Saint of Circumstance and the Speedway to Uncle John's transition [31]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Vince plays wild drums while Bruce responds with nice keyboard runs in the jam [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-06-17.128692.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 165 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd91-06-17.sbd.gardner.3591.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 4.65/5 by 60 [2]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is good, though the first few seconds of the opener are missing; Digital noise is present in a couple spots during the beginning of the drums; Jerry's voice has a relaxed, confident bluesy rasp, with tight leads and transitions [24][25][32]
- **gd1991-06-17.mtx.dan.31606.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 164 min; rated 4.9/5 by 10 [3]
- **gd1991-06-17.nak300.andrewf.86659.sbeok.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Several untracked Dark Star hints appear throughout the concert recording [5]
- **gd1991-06-17.aud.andrewf.86660.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 164 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: Seamless break exists between Discs Two and Three in the recording [7]

## Around the show

- Band noodled on stage for seven to eight minutes before the first song started [26]
- Little Feat provided the opening act for the concert [28]
- Massive thunderstorms poured rain before the show, making the blue tarp floor slippery [30]
- Show was featured on ABC's In Concert Series, with high-quality video footage existing [31]
- Crowd dropped over the wall to the field as the first notes of Eyes rang out [33]
- Cameras taping for ABC's concert series were visible from the reviewer's vantage point [34]
- Most Dark Star-influenced show heard, yet the song itself is never fully played [29]

Also: Show information is embedded in the header of each flac file for display [1]

- **gd1991-06-17.mtx.dan.31606.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Dan Haugh; source: SBD + AUD Matrix Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [3]. Also: Mixed 60% SBD and 40% AUD using Sony R500 DAT and SEK'D Prodif Plus [3]
- **gd1991-06-17.nak300.andrewf.86659.sbeok.flac1648**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-300's w/CP-4 shotgun capsules > Casio DA-7 > Maxell R-DM Dat tape. Mics on stand aprx 8-feet high, set up to the left of the soundboard (stage… [5]

claims.text: First set opener not played since mid-70s, marking a rare return for the song
Audio quality is good, though the first few seconds of the opener are missing
Digital noise is present in a couple spots during the beginning of the drums
Vince plays wild drums while Bruce responds with nice keyboard runs in the jam
Band noodled on stage for seven to eight minutes before the first song started
Little Feat provided the opening act for the concert
Most Dark Star-influenced show heard, yet the song itself is never fully played
Massive thunderstorms poured rain before the show, making the blue tarp floor slippery
Show was featured on ABC's In Concert Series, with high-quality video footage existing
Standout performance includes Saint of Circumstance and the Speedway to Uncle John's transition
Jerry's voice has a relaxed, confident bluesy rasp, with tight leads and transitions
Crowd dropped over the wall to the field as the first notes of Eyes rang out
Cameras taping for ABC's concert series were visible from the reviewer's vantage point
Show information is embedded in the header of each flac file for display
Mixed 60% SBD and 40% AUD using Sony R500 DAT and SEK'D Prodif Plus
Several untracked Dark Star hints appear throughout the concert recording
Seamless break exists between Discs Two and Three in the recording
